title: Halloween Simon
description: Test your memory in Halloween Simon, where the spooky season comes to life! Watch as a series of eerie Halloween characters—like witches, ghosts, and vampires—perform spooky actions on the screen. Your task is simple: memorize the sequence of these haunting movements and repeat them in the exact order! Each round, the sequence grows longer, and the challenge intensifies. Mess up, and you’re out! Can you keep up with the creepy creatures and prove your memory skills? Perfect for all ages, this hauntingly fun game will make your Halloween party unforgettable!
instructions: Mouse click or tap to play
